children: Valuence Merger I approved a one-month extension of its initial business combination deadline to October 3, 2026.
Board approved extending the combination deadline from Sept. 3, 2026 to Oct. 3, 2026 — the fifth of up to 10 monthly extensions.
Company deposited an additional $13,897.14 into its trust account in connection with the extension.
Extensions may be made monthly under the company’s amended memorandum and articles through March 3, 2027.
